dict.string: Wireless Lab uses Bluetooth to list the Bluetooth devices around you and their signal strength. It does not connect to them.
macOS shows Wi-Fi network names only to apps allowed to use Location Services. Wireless Lab uses this to list network names. Your location is not read, stored or sent anywhere.
